records.issue_text: downsize loop in app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb:64-69 writes ImageMagick output to the same path it reads from, which ImageMagick refuses or corrupts
records.rationale: The new loop in `uploads_controller.rb` calls `OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, tempfile.path, "80%", ...)`, i.e., the `from` and `to` arguments are the same file path. Given `OptimizedImage.convert_with` runs an ImageMagick command constructed from these arguments, this change attempts in-place conversion/overwrite of the input file, which can fail or risk corrupting the file depending on ImageMagick behavior. This risk is directly introduced by the diff (same-path read/write).

records.rationale: The new server-side “auto reduce” block in `uploads_controller.rb` decides whether to invoke ImageMagick processing based on `FileHelper.is_image?(filename)` (i.e., the client-controlled `filename`), not on sniffing the uploaded file’s actual bytes: `... && FileHelper.is_image?(filename)` then `OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, ...)` in a loop.
